description: Source code for exception handling and minidump generation in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system for Windows.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions, generates minidumps, manages crash reporting.

classes.name: AutoExceptionHandler
classes.description: Manages exception handler state during exception processing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the exception handler with configuration parameters.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Creates a minidump for the current process.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForException
methods.description: Creates a minidump for a specific exception.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpWithException
methods.description: Handles exception and generates minidump, with callback support.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpWithExceptionForProcess
methods.description: Generates minidump for a specified process and exception info.

methods.name: UpdateNextID
methods.description: Generates a new GUID for the next minidump filename.

methods.name: RegisterAppMemory
methods.description: Registers application memory regions to include in minidumps.
